item.title: Increasing build-up of litter and flytipping, 14th August
item.description:
Along the 50 yard section between the entrance to Dulwich Gallery and the entrance to the Old College Tennis Club, on the far side of the road (the Bel Air side) there has been an ever increasing amount of litter and flytipping behind the greenery fronting the road (bottles, cans, food waste, nitrous oxide canisters, tissues, loo paper, plastic bags etc) which has got steadily worse as the summer has gone on and is an eyesore as well as a potential health hazard in that it could attract flies, rats, and other vermin. This would be particularly good to avoid, as this is a well trodden route for families and children because of the gallery, the park, the tennis club etc

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Gallery Road, Dulwich Village, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
